scope: This bounded research route, not a claim to audit all other workstreams

items.next: Keep expiry explicit; production operation is a separate decision.
Preserve exact outputs, not merely a self-consistent hash.
Future clients should use the same pinned schema and refusal states.
Preserve this path-scoped offline gate; protected merge and wider repository checks remain separate.
Select an owned release process, availability objective, spend ceiling, abuse/rate controls and rollback before extending beyond the research deadline.
Use existing owners to verify authenticated source revisions, access changes and actual durable save/restore/restart behaviour; do not create a duplicate store.
A named consenting reviewer, exact scoped approval, current revocation/expiry checks and independent effect observation are separate from numerical parity.

Choose a concrete real task and rights-cleared development examples; keep an untouched evaluation set, report tail failures and whole-job cost, then qualify a candidate. Do not fine-tune against this public replay bank.
